name: Exp_ColorSchaffTrendCycle
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorSchaffTrendCycle indicator, a momentum-based oscillator that combines moving average convergence/divergence with stochastic smoothing. It opens buy positions when the indicator crosses above the upper threshold and sell positions when it crosses below the lower threshold, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorSchaffTrendCycle指标进行交易，该指标是将移动平均线收敛/发散与随机平滑相结合的动量振荡器。当指标上穿上限阈值时开多仓，下穿下限阈值时开空仓，配有可配置的止损止盈。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Schaff趋势周期指标，该指标本质上是将MACD的收敛发散特性与随机振荡器的平滑技术相结合的动量类指标。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区1的值大于6时产生买入信号，此时若前一根K线的值也大于等于6且允许买入，则开多仓；当指标缓冲区1的值小于2时产生卖出信号，同理若满足条件则开空仓。出场条件依赖于止损和止盈参数，同时也通过反向信号平仓——买入信号时平空仓，卖出信号时平多仓。仓位管理使用固定手数或基于存款比例的动态手数（MM参数为负值时表示固定手数，正值时表示存款比例）。资金管理通过MM参数控制，支持两种模式：负值作为固定手数大小，正值作为存款占比。EA仅在新K线形成时检测信号（SignalBar=0时），避免同根K线内重复交易，同时使用Recount机制确保数据获取失败时重新计算。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Schaff Trend Cycle indicator, which essentially combines the convergence/divergence characteristics of MACD with the smoothing technique of a stochastic oscillator, making it a momentum-type indicator. Entry conditions: when buffer 1 of the indicator exceeds 6, a buy signal is generated; if the previous bar's value is also >= 6 and buying is permitted, a long position is opened. When buffer 1 falls below 2, a sell signal is generated; similarly, if conditions are met, a short position is opened. Exit conditions rely on stop loss and take profit parameters, as well as counter-signal exits — closing short positions on buy signals and closing long positions on sell signals. Position sizing uses either a fixed lot size or a deposit-proportion-based dynamic lot (negative MM value means fixed lot size, positive value means deposit share). Money management is controlled via the MM parameter supporting two modes: negative values as fixed lot sizes and positive values as deposit percentage shares. The EA only checks signals on new bar formation (when SignalBar=0), avoiding repeated trades within the same bar, and uses a Recount mechanism to ensure recalculation when data retrieval fails.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 存款占比或固定手数（负值=固定手数）
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio controlling risk per trade

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description: 最大价格偏差点数（滑点容忍度）

parameters.name: XPhase
parameters.description: 移动平均线平滑参数（-100到+100）

parameters.name: AppliedPrice
parameters.description: 用于指标计算的价格常数

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

pros: 策略逻辑清晰，基于成熟的Schaff趋势周期指标，结合了动量和趋势跟踪双重特性
提供完整的交易权限控制（买入/卖出开仓和平仓独立开关），灵活性高
使用新K线检测机制避免同根K线内重复交易，减少过度交易风险
止损止盈配置完善，默认止损1000点、止盈2000点，盈亏比2:1较为合理
支持多种平滑算法和价格类型，参数可调性强
pros_en: Clear strategy logic based on the mature Schaff Trend Cycle indicator, combining momentum and trend-following dual characteristics
Provides complete trading permission controls (independent buy/sell open and close switches), offering high flexibility
Uses new bar detection mechanism to avoid repeated trades within the same bar, reducing overtrading risk
Well-configured stop loss and take profit with default SL of 1000 points and TP of 2000 points, providing a reasonable 2:1 reward-risk ratio
Supports multiple smoothing algorithms and price types, offering strong parameter adjustability
cons: 止损1000点和止盈2000点数值偏大，在多数货币对上可能导致较大资金回撤
缺乏点差过滤机制，在点差较大时可能产生不利入场
没有移动止损（追踪止损）功能，盈利头寸可能大幅回撤后才触发止盈
指标缓冲区值的阈值判断（>6和<2）使用了硬编码的魔数，可读性和可调整性差
未检测是否已有同方向持仓，可能重复开仓导致仓位过重
cons_en: Stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points are excessively large, potentially causing significant drawdown on most currency pairs
Lacks spread filtering mechanism, which may lead to unfavorable entries during high-spread conditions
No trailing stop functionality, meaning profitable positions may experience significant retracements before hitting take profit
Indicator buffer threshold checks (>6 and <2) use hardcoded magic numbers, resulting in poor readability and adjustability
Does not check for existing same-direction positions, potentially leading to duplicate openings and overconcentration
improvements: 将指标缓冲区阈值（6和2）改为可配置的输入参数，提高策略灵活性和代码可读性
添加持仓检测逻辑，避免同方向重复开仓导致仓位过重
增加移动止损（追踪止损）功能，保护已有盈利
improvements_en: Make indicator buffer thresholds (6 and 2) configurable input parameters to improve strategy flexibility and code readability
Add position checking logic to avoid duplicate same-direction openings that lead to overconcentration
Add trailing stop functionality to protect existing profits

risk_points: 止损点数较大（1000点），若点值较高则单笔亏损可能占账户较大比例
缺乏持仓检测，可能同方向重复开仓导致风险敞口过大
指标阈值使用硬编码魔数，难以根据不同市场条件优化调整
risk_points_en: Large stop loss in points (1000) — if point value is high, a single loss could represent a significant portion of the account
Lack of position checking may lead to duplicate same-direction openings, resulting in excessive risk exposure
Indicator thresholds use hardcoded magic numbers, making it difficult to optimize for different market conditions
